Tendril Bind.name: Tendril Bind
Tendril Bind.description: Vines shoot from the user's forearm at a target across a room and coil around their legs, or around their arms if the user chooses. The target cannot run, kick or use the bound limbs until they break free with a hard effort, cut the vines or the user lets go, and the vines grip without bruising. Strain: light.
